support_intro: This bundle contains no personal data — only version, runtime and boolean health flags. Attach it to a support request.
tour_educator_authoring_body: Use the case wizard to build scenarios; the reporting views show roster, completion, analytics and exports.
tour_educator_classes_body: Create a class and share its join code. The per-tenant Base Class already holds pre-existing activity.
tour_educator_help_body: Settings → Help & Support has the full educator guide and release notes.
tour_educator_welcome_body: Build a class, author cases, and read how your students performed.
tour_student_help_body: Open Settings → Help & Support any time for guides, what is new, and a support bundle.
tour_student_rooms_body: Use the bottom navigator to move between Patient, Examination, Laboratory, Radiology and the Debrief.
tour_student_start_body: Send your first message to the patient to begin the session. Your work is logged for the debrief.
tour_student_welcome_body: You will run a virtual patient case. Nothing here is real or medical advice.
